scientific_integrity: Proof uses explicit rates and closed spectral identity; numerical tests supplement but do not prove global statements. Sources cited by verified arXiv versions and earliest public dates; no independent review or audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three-state continuous-time generators with six strictly positive rates, uniform stationary weights, and nonreal spectrum. Not general stationary distributions, networks of other sizes, or fixed full rate matrix. Divergent entropy approached at boundary with vanishing reverse rates; no singular generator claimed realized. Sharp lower endpoint follows from earlier affinity theory; only exact full fixed-spectral entropy image assessed as new.
title: Complete dissipation fibers for balanced three-state stochastic oscillators
